All these appeals arise out of the impugned common
judgment dated 10.11.2020 passed in Lac Nos.846/2018,
847/2018, 848/2018 and 832/2018 by the learned I Addl.
District and Sessions Judge, Bagalkot to sit at Jamkhandi
(for short, 'Reference Court'), whereby the said claim
petitions/references by the appellants/claimants were
dismissed by the reference Court.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the appellants and learned Government Advocate for the respondents/State and perused the material on record.

3. The material on record discloses that aggrieved by the impugned judgment and award dated 6.2.2017 passed by the SLAO, respective appellants/claimants filed the aforesaid claim petitions/references seeking enhancement/re-determination of the compensation.
The said claim petitions/references having been contested by the respondents/State, the reference Court proceeded to pass the impugned common judgment and award dismissing

the  -4-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:12430-DB  MFA No.100558/2022 C/W MFA No.100557/2022,
 MFA No.100559/2022, MFA No.100560/2022 Tushar S/O Shrikant Alias Shrikanth ... vs The State on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60368329/
3 claim petitions/references, aggrieved by which, the appellants are before this Court by way of present appeals.
 4.

In addition to reiterating the various contentions urged in the appeals and referring to the material on record,
learned counsel for the appellants/claimants invite our attention to the judgment of the reference Court in LAC No.865/2018 and connected matters, arising out of the very same notification, very same village and the same award and in relation to very same acquisition proceedings under which the reference Court vide judgment and award dated 15.07.2022 has enhanced/re-determined the compensation at Rs.5272/- per square meter.

It is submitted that apart from the aforesaid judgment dated 15.07.2022, the reference Court has also granted compensation in favour of other land owners, who are identically/similarly situated and consequently, by applying "Doctrine of Parity", it would be just and appropriate to direct the compensation to be awarded in favour of the appellants/claimants in the present appeals also on par with the compensation awarded by the reference Court in the other matters.

Per contra, learned Government Advocate submits that the impugned judgment and award passed by Tushar S/O Shrikant Alias Shrikanth ... vs The State on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60368329/
4 the reference Court is correct and proper, which do not warrant interference in the present appeals.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the judgment and award passed by the reference Court in LAC No.865/2018 and connected matters have been stayed by this Court in MFA No.103570/2022 and other connected appeals, subject to the appellant/State in the said appeals depositing 50% of the award amount with accrued interest along with all statutory benefits and permitting the respondents/claimants therein to withdraw the said amount.

6. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that the appellants/claimants in the present appeals and respondents/claimants in the aforesaid appeal preferred by the State are identical and similarly situated inasmuch as all the acquired lands are situated in the very same village and are acquired under the very same notification and the claims/references were made by all persons pursuant to the same common award in respect of all the lands.

Under these  -6-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:12430-DB  MFA No.100558/2022 C/W MFA No.100557/2022,
 MFA No.100559/2022, MFA No.100560/2022 circumstances, by applying/invoking "Doctrine of Parity" as held by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the cases of Narendra &
Others Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh & Others1, and Jaiprakash (Dead) by Legal Representatives & Others Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh & Another2, we deem it just Tushar S/O Shrikant Alias Shrikanth ... vs The State on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60368329/
5 and appropriate to set-aside the impugned judgment and award passed by the reference Court.

sentences.text: However, since the reference Court has not quantified the compensation payable in the instant cases, we deem it just and appropriate to remit the matters back to the reference Court with a direction to re-determine the compensation payable in favour of respective appellants/claimants bearing mind the judgment of the reference Court in LAC No.865/2018 and connected matters, dated 15.07.2022 and the observations made above within a stipulated time frame.

7. In the result, we proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
a) All these appeals are allowed.

b) The impugned common judgment and award dated 10.11.2020 passed in LAC Nos.846/2018,
847/2018, 848/2018 and 832/2018 by the reference Court is hereby set- aside.

c) The matters are remitted back to the reference Court for reconsideration afresh in accordance with law bearing in mind the observations made in this order as well as the judgment and award dated 15.07.2022 passed in LAC No.865/2018 and connected matters by the reference Court.
d) The parties undertake to appear before the reference Court on 30.10.2023 without awaiting further notice from the reference Court.
e) The reference Court is directed to reconsider the matters afresh and pass appropriate orders as stated supra on or before 01.12.2023.
f) Registry is directed to transmit the TCR in these appeals to the reference Court to enable compliance of this order.

g) Registry to refund the entire Court fee paid on all the memorandum of appeals back to the Tushar S/O Shrikant Alias Shrikanth ... vs The State on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60368329/
6 appellants without any delay.
